name: Bug report
about: Create a report to help us improve
title: ''
labels: bug

---

**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

**Expected behavior**
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

**To Reproduce**
Steps that lead to the bug. Include what mod is causing the conflict, if it is a conflict.
This category isn't necessary, but greatly appreciated.

**Latest.log**
Attach a log file for when the bug occurred, especially if it was a crash. Mandatory if you want the issue to be resolved in a timely manner.

**Screenshots**
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

**Versions**
 - Minecraft Version (e.g. 1.20.1)
 - Synapse version (e.g. v1.0.2)
 - Version of the conflicting mod, if applicable.

**Additional context**
Add any other context about the problem here.
